messages:
Ivy (Partnerships): Planning note: EdgeCore x Redwood marketplace showcase at MeshCon next Thu. Need speakers, pod leads, demo fallbacks, and swag split between partners.
Sam (Marketplace): Marketplace tile needs final blurb + 800x450 screenshot by Tue noon. Can someone take a clean UI shot of the demo?
Diego (EdgeCore): I can capture screenshot after we finalize UI changes tonight. Will upload to gcs.
Rina (Events): Format: 25m talk + 40m hands-on pods (onsite+remote). We need 4 pod volunteers on-call.
Ivy (Partnerships): Volunteers: Ivy, Diego, Sam (marketplace triage), Hannah for ops. Ben for swag pickup.
Hannah (Ops): Swag kit plan: 180 demo kits (carry-on), 40 sponsor-only packs. Kit list: branded cable, mini guide, sticker sheet, QR feedback card.
Ben (Supply): Budget estimate ~ $8.5k. Shipping via FedEx economy. Need PO Mon 9am to meet cut-off. ship-bot: Shipping label reserved -> FEDEX-TEMP-444.
Lena (Marketing): Need headshots + 1-liners by Wed EOD. Also want a short teaser GIF for socials. Can someone record a 15s clip?
Diego (EdgeCore): I'll record a 15s clip of the live inference flow and push to s3://events/edgecore-meshcon/teaser.mp4
Sam (Marketplace): Fallback for live pods: primary = EdgeCore private node, fallback = Redwood hosted sandbox + prerecorded walkthrough. Volunteers should know how to flip to fallback.
Ivy (Partnerships): Simple fallback command for runbook: `curl -X POST https://ops.redwood/switch -d '{"env":"hosted-sandbox"}'`
Hannah (Ops): I'll add a warmup script to the runbook and schedule a cache prime 10m before session.
Rina (Events): Run-through Wed 8am PT. Please RSVP. Volunteer roster by Tue noon for security badge list.
Ben (Supply): I'll pickup kits at 6:30am day-of and meet venue load-in at 7:15am. If we scale below 180 let me know Tue.
Lena (Marketing): Post-event follow-up: QR on kit -> 90s survey + opt-in newsletter. I'll design the card and add UTM tags.
Ivy (Partnerships): Action items: 1) Diego -> screenshot + 15s clip (today), 2) Sam -> staging tile + blurb (Tue noon), 3) Ben -> PO + labels (Mon AM), 4) Hannah -> runbook + warmup (Wed morning), 5) Lena -> assets + QR (Wed EOD). Run-through Wed 8am PT.
ship-bot: Label created FEDEX-TEMP-444. Replace with real tracking after PO.
Ivy (Partnerships): Thanks all. Will ping privately if any blockers. :raised_hands:
